Illustrations
Illustration guidelines for empty states, onboarding flows, and feature highlights.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

when-to-use  When to Use - Consistent illustration usage reinforces brand identity and helps users understand context at
             a glance. Use illustrations in these contexts:
guidelines   Guidelines - Keep illustrations consistent in style across the product.
placement    Placement - For an empty state, pass the illustration to the `icon` slot of `EmptyState`, which centers it
             above the title and description. Typical illustration sizes range from 120px for inline empty states to
             240px for full-page onboarding screens....
